title: Trajectory: managed Macs that do not report
description: Find managed Macs where the Trajectory Jamf script succeeded but Trajectory sends no heartbeat. See the trajectory-mdm user guide, setup topic, section Find Macs that do not report.

definition.content:
The table lists each Mac by its device ID: the Mac's hardware UUID, which Jamf Pro shows as the UDID.

- **Successful script runs:** runs of the Trajectory Jamf script that ended with outcome `ok` in the last 7 days. An empty cell means that the Mac sends heartbeats but had no successful run.
- **Trajectory heartbeat:** the highest number of Trajectory background processes that the Mac reported at one time in the last 7 days. `0` means that the Mac sent no heartbeat.

Macs with `0` come first. They got Trajectory but do not report. Macs that reported and then stopped show in the monitor **Trajectory: managed Mac stopped reporting**.
